worldcombat.skill.hiddenpower.summary: Gathers the type hidden in the user's body into a sphere and fires it; the type is decided by the user's individual values.
worldcombat.skill.hiddenpower.descriptio: Gather the user's inherent type into a sphere and fire it at the target: about %1$s special damage; after %2$s s of gathering it flies straight at %3$s blocks per tick, with a range of %4$s blocks.

The sphere's type is fixed by the parity of the user's six individual values - that individual's own Hidden Power type. Damage is dealt as that type, so it gains same-type bonus and follows type match-ups; the same move has a different type in different individuals.

The sphere is a real projectile that flies straight, with a %1$s-block hit radius; aim it freely at a direction or point. It bursts on the first body it meets, dealing one hit only to a non-ally, and shatters on the first block it strikes, without piercing and leaving nothing behind.
